description: Use this when a visitor asks about separately ticketed event nights at a supported resort, such as Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party, Disney Jollywood Nights or Halloween Horror Nights: which nights are on sale or sold out, and the lowest price. Covers up to 60 days. Parky cannot sell tickets.

from.description: First night, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

resort.description: Resort key or shorthand: wdw, dlr, uor or ush.

to.description: Last night, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to 29 days after from; at most 60 days in all.

name: parky_get_event_nights
title: Get ticketed event nights
